# -h shows the usage and the flags, and exits 0.
exec rexdiff -h
stderr '^usage: rexdiff \[flags\] \[repo\]'
stderr '-layout value'
stderr '-config string'
! stdout .

# -version prints the version. A build for development has none.
exec rexdiff -version
stdout '^\(devel\)$'

# install -h writes no file.
exec rexdiff install -h
! exists .config/rex

# A build for development cannot update itself, and says so.
! exec rexdiff update
stderr '^rexdiff: this rexdiff cannot update itself'
! exec rexdiff update extra
stderr 'update takes no arguments'
